company.name: Dalil AI
company.shortDescription: Dalil AI offers AI-driven lead insights, deal scoring, task updates, record creation, and CRM access via chat or desktop tools.
company.description: Dalil AI provides an AI-powered sales assistant that integrates with CRM systems and messaging platforms to streamline customer data management and sales interactions. It reviews CRM activity to produce real-time insights on leads and deals, using AI-based scoring and automated signals to inform sales representatives about potential opportunities. It enables record creation, task updates, email generation, and follow-up reminders via WhatsApp chat or desktop interface. It also offers customizable views for leads, contacts, accounts, and deals, allowing teams to tailor pipelines, filter records, and collaborate.
